jobs.title: Medical Field Case Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**
Job Description:
**This is a full\-time, work\-from\-home position. The candidate must be located in the** **Denver, Colorado** **area due to regular local travel for in\-person patient appointments.** **Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, mileage and travel reimbursement, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands\-on workers’ compensation case management training.  

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Field Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost\-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:* Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
* Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
* Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non\-occupational.
* Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as attend injured worker’s appointments when appropriate, prepare status updates for submittal to customers, and other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:
* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
* **Experience:** 2\+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation\-related experience preferred.
* **Skills:** Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
* **Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:**
	+ Active Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
	+ URAC\-recognized certification in case management preferred (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN\-S, RN\-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).
* **Travel:** Must have reliable transportation and be able to travel to and attend in\-person appointments with injured workers in assigned geography.
* **Internet:** Must have reliable internet.
* **Transportation:** Must have reliable transportation and be able to travel to and attend in\-person appointments with injured workers in assigned geography.


Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well\-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full\-time or part\-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $71,000 \- $85,000 annually. In addition to the base salary, you will be eligible to participate in our productivity\-based bonus program. Your total compensation, including base pay and potential bonus, will be based on a number of factors including skills, experience, education, and performance metrics.  

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.*

jobs.description:
**Board\-Certified Behavior Analyst \- Clinical Supervisor Teens \& Young Adults (Ages 12–21\)** 

**M–F 8–4 \| 7 Weeks Paid Time Off \| Arvada, CO**

**Salary: $75,000 – $86,700/year** 

**Full\-time \| Center\-based, no in\-home travel**

**A BCBA role with a school\-year rhythm**

Most BCBA jobs ask for evenings, weekends, and hours in the car between client homes. This one doesn't. You'll work Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, in one building, with **up to 7 weeks of paid time off every year**. That includes 5 weeks of paid center closures: a week in spring, a week in summer, Thanksgiving week, and up to two weeks over the winter holidays. That's on top of your PTO, sick leave, and paid holidays.

**Who we are**

Evoke Behavioral Health is a **locally owned** Colorado organization serving individuals with autism, intellectual and developmental disabilities, and co\-occurring diagnoses. In 2025 we moved into a **newly renovated** facility in Arvada with two outdoor playgrounds, a full gym, and an advanced sensory room.

You won't be working alone. Our team includes BCBAs, LCSWs, special education teachers, RBTs, and mental health assistants, plus on\-site nursing, HR, admin, and maintenance staff. When a situation escalates or a case gets complicated, the right people are down the hall.

**What you'll do**

You'll serve as clinical lead for individuals in our **Secondary/Transition Program**, a population where behavior analysis can change what adulthood looks like: independence, vocational skills, and communication that works outside the classroom.

* Conduct assessments and design individualized treatment plans for teens and young adults
* Lead a team of approximately 6\-7 RBTs and Behavior Specialists (about 800–1,000 RBT hours per month), providing supervision and training
* Supervise BCBA trainees and help grow the next generation of clinicians
* Partner with families through caregiver training and collaborate with our interdisciplinary team
* Use data to guide clinical decisions and keep documentation current
* Provide in\-the\-moment clinical support, including Safety Care when needed

**What you bring**

* Active BCBA certification in good standing
* 2\+ years as a BCBA, experience with adolescents, high\-intensity behavior, co\-occurring diagnoses, interdisciplinary teams, preffered
* Master's degree in ABA, Psychology, Special Education, or a related field
* Experience training and supervising behavior technicians
* Experience working with individuals with autism and/or developmental disabilities
* Ability to pass state and federal background checks
* CPR/First Aid certification (can be obtained within 30 days of hire)
* Ability to physically participate in Safety Care, including kneeling, moving quickly, and lifting up to 40 lbs.

**Benefits**

* **Up to 7 weeks paid time off:** 5 weeks of paid center closures, 7 paid holidays, 40 hours PTO, 48 hours sick leave
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an HSA with eligible plan
* 401(k) with up to 3% company match
* Internal and external CEU opportunities
* Leadership and growth opportunities

**Evoke Behavioral Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer**. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or veteran status.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position or participate in the hiring process, please contact us at B.fix@evokebehavioralhealth.com.

jobs.title: Behavioral Health Specialist (Social Work/Counselor IV) - Division of Youth Services, Denver
jobs.description:
**Department Information**
--------------------------

  

  

**This position will be accepting applications from residents and non\-residents of Colorado.**  

  

**This announcement is open to potential candidates who are legal residents of the United States. All legal residents of the United States are eligible to apply and compete. If appointed to a position, applicants from outside of Colorado will be required to relocate to Colorado prior to their start date, at their own expense.**  

  

  

Please note: This recruitment may be used to fill multiple vacancies.

  

  

  

**Division of Youth Services \- Youth Services Central Administration Office**  

**About the Division of Youth Services:**
  

The Division of Youth Services (DYS) provides a continuum of residential and non\-residential services that encompass juvenile detention, commitment, and parole. DYS is the agency statutorily mandated to provide for the care and supervision of youth committed by the District Court to the custody of the Colorado Department of Human Services. The Division operates fifteen secure facilities that serve youth between the ages of 10 and 21 who are pre\-adjudicated, sentenced, or committed. The Division also contracts with numerous private residential and non\-residential service providers throughout the State. For pre\-adjudicated youth, the Division is also responsible for the management and oversight of Colorado Youth Detention Continuum, a State\-funded, locally administered program that provides services to youth at risk of further progressing into the juvenile justice system. In addition to residential programming, the Division administers juvenile parole services throughout the State.
  

  

We invite you to explore the DYS website and learn about the services provided to youth, families, and local communities in the State of Colorado at: https://www.colorado.gov/cdhs/dys
**Description of Job**
----------------------

  

  

You are required to work at your assigned work location during your scheduled work times.  

  

*Please note: Work arrangements are subject to change at any time*  

  

  

  

**Summary of Work Unit:**
The Division of Youth Services (DYS) provides care and supervision of youth committed and detained by the courts, with a mission to build skills and competencies that support healthy development, accountability, and successful reintegration into the community. The Behavioral Health and Medical Services (BHMS) Unit provides statewide leadership, guidance, and oversight for behavioral health, medical, dental, psychological, neuropsychological, substance use, and sex\-offense\-specific services. The unit ensures that all services align with DYS policy, Colorado law, NCCHC standards, and evidence\-based practice expectations.
  

  

**About the Position:**  

  

The Behavioral Health Specialist (Social Worker/Counselor IV) ensures consistent delivery of high\-quality, evidence\-based behavioral health services and strengthens overall client care. This role directly supports client care by ensuring staff are equipped with the skills and knowledge necessary to provide effective, trauma\-informed, and individualized services.


In addition to training and oversight responsibilities, this position will provide direct youth/client care for critical cases needed to support service continuity, model best practices, and respond to emerging or high\-acuity situations. Through ongoing coaching, monitoring, and quality improvement efforts, this position promotes positive client outcomes, reduces risk, and ensures services are delivered safely, consistently, and in alignment with best practices.  

  

  



**Summary of Duties:**


**Clinical Assessment, Treatment, and Documentation**


* Provide advanced, licensed clinical services to youth with complex mental health, substance use, trauma\-related, and criminogenic needs within the Division of Youth Services.
* Conduct comprehensive biopsychosocial assessments; synthesizes collateral information from medical, educational, legal, and family systems; and formulates clinical impressions that inform individualized treatment planning.
* Deliver individual, group, and family therapy using evidence\-based modalities (e.g., CBT, DBT, Motivational Interviewing) and apply trauma\-informed and Sanctuary\-aligned practices.
* Develop, implement, and continuously update treatment plans aligned with risk, needs, and protective factors, and coordinate care with multidisciplinary partners.

--------------------------

  

  

**This position will be accepting applications from residents and non\-residents of Colorado.**  

  

**This announcement is open to potential candidates who are legal residents of the United States. All legal residents of the United States are eligible to apply and compete. If appointed to a position, applicants from outside of Colorado will be required to relocate to Colorado prior to their start date, at their own expense.**  

  

  

Please note: This recruitment may be used to fill multiple vacancies.

  

  

  

**Division of Youth Services \- Youth Services Central Administration Office**  

**About the Division of Youth Services:**
  

The Division of Youth Services (DYS) provides a continuum of residential and non\-residential services that encompass juvenile detention, commitment, and parole. DYS is the agency statutorily mandated to provide for the care and supervision of youth committed by the District Court to the custody of the Colorado Department of Human Services. The Division operates fifteen secure facilities that serve youth between the ages of 10 and 21 who are pre\-adjudicated, sentenced, or committed. The Division also contracts with numerous private residential and non\-residential service providers throughout the State. For pre\-adjudicated youth, the Division is also responsible for the management and oversight of Colorado Youth Detention Continuum, a State\-funded, locally administered program that provides services to youth at risk of further progressing into the juvenile justice system. In addition to residential programming, the Division administers juvenile parole services throughout the State.
  

  

We invite you to explore the DYS website and learn about the services provided to youth, families, and local communities in the State of Colorado at: https://www.colorado.gov/cdhs/dys

jobs.title: GROUP SUPERVISOR
jobs.description:
✨Join a group of passionate advocates on our mission to improve the lives of youth! Rite of Passage Team is hiring for a Group Supervisor at Mt. Evans Qualifying House in Idaho Springs, CO ✨



The Colorado Qualifying House (Q House) is a transitional housing \& positive skill development program located on over 70 acres of land at the bottom of Mt. Blue Sky. The Q house serves as a Residential Treatment Center that provides male youth ages 16\-21 with opportunities for positive growth through evidence\-based interventions and innovative programming, including on\-site school \& vocational opportunities, therapeutic support, community engagement, and tailored programming that is co\-created in collaboration with all youth and staff.



The Q House program subscribes to the four principles of effective intervention: risk assessment, addressing needs, providing individualized treatment, and ensuring fidelity. By following these core principles, Colorado Qualifying House supports youth in developing the skills and resources necessary to lead self\-determined lives without experiencing the barriers of future systems involvement. Our trauma\-informed approach emphasizes collaborative growth and recognizes that every person – staff and youth alike – has goals that we can collectively use our knowledge and experiences to mutually support.


**Pay:** $55,000 annually  

  

**Perks \& Benefits:**


* 3\.5 day work weeks (Sunday\-Tuesday 7am\-7pm, Wednesday 7am\-3pm)
* Optional on\-site housing to ease travel during your shift days if desired
* Free shift meals and snacks (tell us what you’d like!)
* Medical, Dental, Vision and company paid Life Insurance within 90 days
* 401k match of up to 6% after 1 year of employment,
* Paid Time Off that can be used as soon as it accrues
* Tuition Reimbursement Options
* Hiring preference for future leadership \& career development opportunities
* And more here: ROP\-benefits\-and\-perks\-2 (https://riteofpassage.com/wp\-content/uploads/2024/10/ROP\-benefits\-perks\-2024\-v2\.pdf)

  

  

**What you will do:**



The Group Supervisor facilitates collaboration among staff and youth to ensure all expectations of the program and its services are met. They will assess the day’s needs and work with the team to identify leads for each task, and ensure completion according to the specifications required by licensing and shown to have the greatest success in implementation. This includes the morning cadence (wake up, chores, physical education), participating in work, school, or community service, and the evening cadence (dinner, positive skill development groups, and leisure time before bed). We strongly believe in the importance of Continuous Quality Improvement, and are looking for an active partner eager to help the site find the best methods and approaches for exceeding our goals – as staff, youth, and the program as a whole.



This Group Supervisor will work on A Shift (Sunday – Wednesday afternoon) and have a Coach Counselor and Night Coach Counselor as direct reports. All on\-site staff (including the Teacher, Program Manager, and other support staff throughout the day) are charged with the safety, care, and around\-the\-clock supervision of students in the program. Most of the time the Group Supervisor will be at the Qualifying House in Idaho Springs, with consistent community outings in Clear Creek County and the greater Denver Metro area (volunteering with the local Elks Lodge, going to museums, hikes \& ski trips, etc). This role will work with the team to make sure regardless of location or programming (at the house, working in community, going on field trips) there is active supervision and support provided to the youth according to licensing requirements and in line with student needs.



“Kids with trauma history don’t need more punishment; and – quite frankly – they don’t need more stickers” \- Dr. Ross Greene



“I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essentials facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach, and not, when I came to die, discover that I had not lived.” \- Henry David Thoreau


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* Have direct care experience working with at\-risk youth and/or the systems they frequently interact with
* Be empathetic, trauma\-informed, and able to model the positive impact of building healthy relationships
* Have experience in a supervisory role.
* Be at least 21 years of age.
* Have a high school diploma or equivalent.
* Be able to pass a criminal background check, illegal drug screen, physical, and TB test.
* The ability to work 3\.5 days/week in Idaho Springs (preference given to candidates in the greater Denver Metro area)
* Have reliable transportation and able to drive in winter conditions


**Applicants that stand out may:**


* Have a BA/BS in Human Services or related fields, or are actively working towards one
* Have lived experience that mirrors some of the lives of our students (navigating state systems, foster care, incarceration, or poverty support programs)
* Have previous experience with or knowledge of ACEs, trauma\-informed care, peer support, and other related research \& methodologies


After 40 years of improving the lives of youth, we are looking for passionate advocates to continue the legacy of helping young people become successful adults. As a **Youth Mentor,** you will have the unique opportunity to create a positive, safe and supportive environment for the youth we serve while building a career rich in growth opportunities and self\-fulfillment.

Provides social work services to patients, their families and/or significant others through counseling, emotional support, assisting with environmental needs, crisis intervention, and group leadership.
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** **:**

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:**

1\. Master's degree in social work or related field


2\. Current social worker licensure as required by the state where services are being performed:


**WV** : Licensed Graduate Social Worker (LGSW), Licensed Certified Social Worker (LCSW ) **OR** Licensed Independent Social Worker (LICSW) through the West Virginia Board of Social Work


**PA:** No state licensure required


**OH:** Licensed Social Worker (LSW), Licensed Independent Social Worker (LISW), **OR** Licensed Independent Social Worker\-Supervision (LISW\-S) through the Ohio Board of Social Work


**MD:** Licensed Masters Social Worker (LMSW), Licensed Certified Social Worker (LCSW), **OR** Licensed Certified Social Worker\-Clinical (LISW\-C) through the Maryland Board of Social Work

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:**

1\. Certification in Case Management


2\. **PA:** Licensed Social Worker (LSW) **OR** Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) through the Pennsylvania Board of Social Workers, Marriage and Family Therapists and Professional Counselors
  

**EXPERIENCE:**  

1\. Two (2\) years' social work experience.

5\. Provide consultative services to health care team members within scope of care definitions as needed. Maintain a working knowledge of relevant medical/legal issues that impact on patient care, e.g., advance directives, child and elder abuse.
  

6\. Provide education to patients and families around issues related to adaptation to the patient's diagnosis, illness, treatment and/or life situation.

jobs.title: Training Program Coordinator, Commercial Education & Effectiveness
jobs.description:
Are you motivated to participate in a dynamic, multi\-tasking environment? Do you want to join a company that invests in its employees? Are you seeking a position where you can use your skills while continuing to be challenged and learn? Then we encourage you to dive deeper into this opportunity.


We believe in career development and empowering our employees. Not only do we provide career coaches internally, but we offer many training opportunities to expand your knowledge base! We have highly competitive benefits with a variety HMO and PPO options. We have company 401k match along with an Employee Stock Purchase Program. We have tuition reimbursement, leadership development, and even start employees off with 16 days of paid time off plus holidays. We offer wellness courses and have highly engaged employee resource groups. Come join the Neo team and be part of our amazing World Class Culture!

**NeoGenomics has an opening for a Senior Training Program Specialist, Commercial Education \& Effectiveness who wants to continue to learn in order to allow our company to grow. The ideal candidate will be located Remote Non\-CA with travel to Fort Myers for a week every other month.**

**Now that you know what we're looking for in talent, let us tell you why you'd want to work at NeoGenomics:**


As an employer, we promise to provide you with a purpose driven mission in which you have the opportunity to save lives by improving patient care through the exceptional work you perform. Together, we will become the world's leading cancer reference laboratory.

**Position Summary**
--------------------


The Senior Training Program Specialist owns the operational backbone of the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness (CEE) training calendar. The role plans and runs the logistics for approximately five new hire training classes per year, each built as a virtual week followed by a week\-long in\-person program, and partners with the corporate event planning team on the Global Commercial Meeting (GCM) and Summer Session. The Specialist schedules and confirms presenters, manages hotel and program logistics, prepares materials, administers the learning platform and the CEE SharePoint site, and maintains attendance, completion, and evaluation records.


This is a program and project management role. The Specialist is the single point of accountability for ensuring programs run on time, on budget, and without disruption to learning.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Own the end\-to\-end logistics plan and timeline for approximately five new hire training classes per year, working backward from each class start date across both the virtual and in\-person portions of the program.
* Schedule and confirm presenters for virtual training sessions, including invitations, calendar management, content collection, quality review, and same\-day support.
* Manage hotel, venue, and participant travel logistics for week\-long in\-person programs, including room blocks, meeting space, audiovisual requirements, food and beverage coordination, and accessibility needs.
* Partner with the corporate event planning team on the Global Commercial Meeting (GCM) and Summer Session, owning the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness training workstream.
* Serve as the onsite point of contact during training programs, managing materials, shipping, badges, signage, room setup, and agenda changes.
* Track and reconcile program spend against budget, including vendor contracts, hotel invoices, purchase orders, and cost summaries.
* Build and maintain the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness SharePoint site, including document libraries, permissions, metadata, version control, and naming conventions.
* Audit and retire sales training content on a scheduled basis and coordinate required internal reviews for clinical, marketing, and claims\-related materials.
* Administer the learning platform, including curricula, enrollments, assignment rules, reporting, and learner record migration activities.
* Maintain accurate attendance, completion, assessment, and evaluation records and create post\-program reports.
* Utilize Microsoft Office and other digital tools to organize, track, and report training activities.
* Coordinate and facilitate communication within the commercial organization regarding training events, schedules, and updates.
* Support onboarding for new sales and support team members by ensuring system access and training resources are available before day one.
* Administer post\-training surveys and 60\- and 90\-day follow\-up assessments and summarize findings.
* Prepare manager touchpoint materials, including pre\-class briefing packets and post\-class coaching guides.
* Provide administrative support to the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness team and perform other duties as assigned.

**Experience, Education and Qualifications**
--------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Five or more years of experience in program or project coordination, corporate meeting and event planning, training coordination, or a sales or support role.
* Experience in a diagnostic laboratory, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare environment preferred.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a cross\-functional environment.
* Experience coordinating multi\-day, multi\-presenter meetings or training programs, including registrations, room blocks, banquet event orders, and vendor invoicing.
* Strong professional verbal and written communication skills and a customer\-focused approach.
* Demonstrated SharePoint proficiency, including document libraries, permissions, metadata management, and version control.
* Ability to effectively follow up with senior leaders and subject matter experts to secure commitments, presentations, and approvals on schedule.
* Learning management system administration experience preferred.

jobs.title: Continuing Education Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Continuing Education Program Coordinator is responsible for supporting the administration, development, growth, and promotion of the organization’s continuing education programs. This position combines program coordination with business development, instructor recruitment, course development support, customer service, and marketing.

A significant focus of this position will be helping grow the continuing education program by identifying and recruiting qualified physicians, psychologists, and other professionals to develop and present courses, assisting with the development and launch of new educational offerings, and increasing awareness and enrollment through social media and other promotional channels.

The Continuing Education Program Coordinator will work closely with the supervisor to ensure courses and programs are well organized, professionally presented, and administered in accordance with applicable continuing education requirements.

Essential Duties and ResponsibilitiesContinuing Education Program Administration

* Assist with the day\-to\-day administration of the continuing education website and programs.
* Respond to participant questions regarding courses, registration, certificates, course access, and other administrative matters.
* Follow up with participants, instructors, and prospective instructors as needed.
* Monitor course registrations, completion requirements, evaluations, and other administrative components of continuing education programs.
* Assist with maintaining accurate course information, instructor information, schedules, and educational materials on the website.
* Identify administrative or participant issues and coordinate appropriate follow\-up and resolution.
* Help ensure continuing education documentation and records are maintained according to organizational and applicable regulatory requirements.

Program Growth \& Instructor Recruitment

A major responsibility of this position is assisting with the continued growth of the continuing education program.

* Identify and recruit physicians, psychologists, and other qualified professionals who may be interested in developing or presenting continuing education courses.
* Conduct outreach to prospective instructors and presenters through email, professional networks, associations, social media, and other appropriate sources.
* Follow up with prospective instructors and help guide them through the course development and onboarding process.
* Develop and maintain relationships with existing instructors to encourage additional course development.
* Research potential course topics, presenters, professional trends, and areas of educational demand.
* Identify opportunities to expand the organization's course offerings and audience.
* Track recruitment and course\-development efforts and provide regular updates to the supervisor.

Course Development

* Assist with the development of new continuing education courses under the direction and guidance of the supervisor.
* Coordinate with instructors to obtain course materials, biographies, disclosures, learning objectives, examinations or assessments, references, and other required information.
* Assist instructors with understanding course\-development requirements and timelines.
* Review submitted materials for completeness and coordinate revisions or additional information as directed by the supervisor.
* Assist with organizing and preparing course content for publication on the continuing education platform.
